plugins.cameraPermission: Locked In Fitness uses the camera so you can photograph a meal to estimate its nutrition. The photo is resized on your device and removed from it right after analysis.

plugins.photosPermission: Locked In Fitness can use a photo you choose from your library to estimate a meal, or to share in Community if you choose to. Photos are resized on your device and stripped of location data. A meal photo is removed from your device right after analysis. A Community photo appears in the feed right away; you can delete it any time.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Locked In Fitness uses Face ID so you can open the app without typing your PIN. Your PIN always works instead.
